This little plot is only a tenth of a hectare and I grow a mix of things on it together — it is close to the house so I tend it myself along with my family. I do not waste the costly DAP and urea on this small mixed patch; I save that for the bigger grain plots. What I do put on it is the manure from our animals and some household compost, which keeps the soil living. The seeds I use are my own, saved from last season, and I do not buy chemicals for it.
